Overview

Burgas is a city in Burgas with a population of 202,694. A major Black Sea port and industrial center, known for its beautiful Sea Garden, the Burgas Lakes, and proximity to the Sunny Beach resort. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
